features.name: Own compact handgun-like SMG outline: short projecting front, rectangular upper with broad side features, rear raked grip and distinct trigger opening. Do not enlarge it into a conventional stocked carbine.
Source describes basic model lacking accessories and full-auto mode. This does not require visible operational labels/effects.

Assigned sole final reviewer inspected source-form-approved detail, actual clay, native foreground/openings, final2048 masks/teal views and paired overlay. Actual detailed/clay compared once to own WARRIOR10 art Arsenal25/PDF27 and exact source constraints. Compact receiver, short projecting cylinder, rear raked grip, side disc/lever, top structural members and major part boundaries match. Clay has no fine receiver channels, barrel-side cuts, grip checkering or fastener dimples. Disc rim is the bevel of a large raised assembly, not an ornamental channel. Neutral colors/unshown depth remain artistic interpretation. No manual RGB edits required. Preserve both actual white trigger clearances and the thin trigger/guard. Muzzle is a dark solid end-face recess rather than a through-alpha opening. No invented hole. Major source form/framing and thin trigger structure retained. No clipped part, detached subject, broad fringe or cast shadow. One common crop/scale/offset; original1254 square resampled2048 square, not native2K. Native RGB is unchanged from both original images.
